Complete [[The Frost Gate]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Open the [[The Frost Gate (landmark)|Frost Gate]] in the [[Northern Shiverpeaks]].
* *BONUS* Secure the [[Secret Siege Weapon Plans|secret siege weapon plans]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 15 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 22 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 37 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per [[The Frost Gate#Walkthrough|The Frost Gate]] mission.
